in_marathi.name: Vivak
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vivak हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Vivak is a Sanskrit and Hindu name, derived from the root 'Vij' meaning knowledge. It signifies intelligence, wisdom, and insight. This name is suitable for a child who is destined to grow up to be a wise and knowledgeable individual.
